IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: PROVIDE QUALITY BEHAVIORAL PROGRAMS FOR CHILDREN, ADOLESCENTS AND ADULTS IN NEED.
IRS990.MissionDesc: TO ENHANCE AND IMPROVE THE QUALITY OF LIFE FOR FAMILIES AND INDIVIDUALS OF ALL AGES, BY PROVIDING AN ARRAY OF MENTAL/BEHAVIORAL HEALTH, EDUCATIONAL AND SOCIAL SERVICES.
IRS990.Desc: Stein Education CenterThe Stein Education Center provides educational, social, and training programs for children and adults with developmental disabilities, which include autism, epilepsy, cerebral palsy, and other neurological conditions.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: Donald K. Allen ParentCare Family Recovery Center (ParentCare)ParentCare provides treatment and care case management programs primarily focused on women (perinatal or peripartum) with substance use disorders and/or co-occurring behavioral health diagnoses. Programs include ParentCare East and Central, Perinatal Case Management, Dependency Drug Court, CalWORKS, Accessible Depression & Anxiety Peripartum Treatment (ADAPT) and child care.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: Learning Assistance Center (LAC)LAC provides school-based mental health treatment to MediCal eligible students that are identified as having psychiatric conditions that interfere with educational progress. LAC clinicians, psychiatrists conduct assessment, case management, and treatment with students and families in coordination with school personnel.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: The Organizations are a public charity, and are exempt from income taxes under Section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code and Section 23701(d) of the California Revenue and Taxation Code. The Organizations, however, may occasionally be subject to taxes on unrelated business income. The Organizations believe that they have appropriate support for any tax positions taken, and, as such, do not have any uncertain tax positions that are material to the combined financial statements. The Organizations are not a private foundation.The Organizations Return of Organization Exempt from Income Tax for the years ended September 30, 2024, 2023, 2022 and 2021 are subject to examination by the Internal Revenue Service and State taxing authorities, generally three-to-four years after the returns were filed.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: OTHER PROGRAM SERVICES 4: Mental Health Contracts (MHC)MHC provides school-based mental health treatment to special education students identified by partnering school districts under contract. Services include outpatient therapy, intensive outpatient programs, behavior management and psychiatric consultation. OTHER PROGRAM SERVICES 5: Learning Assistance Center (LAC)LAC provides school-based mental health treatment to MediCal eligible students that are identified as having psychiatric conditions that interfere with educational progress. LAC clinicians, psychiatrists conduct assessment, case management, and treatment with students and families in coordination with school personnel. OTHER PROGRAM SERVICES 6: BridgesBridges provides prevention, early intervention, case management and treatment services to youth and adults with substance use disorders and behavioral health diagnoses. Programs include Substance Abuse Services (probation youth), Bridges Teen Treatment & Recovery Center (adolescents), Bridges Regional Recovery Center (adult co-ed), SAFIR and On-Track. OTHER PROGRAM SERVICES 7: Integrated Behavioral HealthIntegrated behavioral health provides a range of outpatient diagnostic and treatment services for children, adolescents, and young adults. OTHER PROGRAM SERVICES 8: Sober Living ApartmentsThe Sober Living Apartments provides for lower cost or subsidized housing to at-risk families undergoing treatment, primarily through ParentCare.
